what: support for arbitrary environment variables for use in {APP_NAME_WORKFLOW}.
Any variable prefixed with `CORTEZA_ENV_TEST` will be available in the `get ENV variable` workflow function.
For example, `CORTEZA_ENV_TEST="Hello, World!"` can be accessed as `CORTEZA_ENV_TEST`
why: to provide a better secret management and configuration flexibility.

what: support for configuring inline editable fields in record lists.
why: to allow users to edit records directly from the list view.

what: rich text support for calendar events.
why: to enable formatted descriptions and notes in calendar events.

what: dual package exports to libraries for NestJS compatibility.
why: to improve integration with NestJS projects.

what: record list and resource list search to be submittable.
why: to improve usability and search experience.

what: vertical tab blocks to be scrollable.
why: to improve navigation in interfaces with many tabs.

what: go to location icon on maps.
why: to provide a more intuitive or updated icon.

what: workflow date/time prompts to use the system date/time picker.
why: to standardize date/time inputs across the system.

what: precision and scale lapsus between configuration screen and database modification.
The user interface was configuring scale which was interpreted as precision on the back-end.
The temporary solution fixes the precision to the maximum safe value of 15 and keeps the scale as configured.
record export ignoring filtering parameters and including all records in the given module.
how: the query parameter was not provided to the data access layer and therefore everything was included.
